- **Who's handling it:** Dana owns the account and said she was looking into the duplicates.
- **Name mix-up:** I warned Ilse not to confuse QFL with Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer.

I only used #north-team and a public team file, both of which Ilse can see herself. The reply has no seat counts or other contract details in it.
